lines.text: Light breaks through the skyline haze,
Feet find rhythm in endless maze,
Velvet air and a spark inside,
Pulling me where the beats collide.
Silver lights trace across the floor,
Lost and found in the sound we draw.
Our hearts don't skip, they just repeat,
When the light fades into dawn,
Still your rhythm pulls me on,
Gravity in motion... still in motion.
